renderer.handoff_note: franken_engine produces JSON fixtures; /dp/frankentui owns rich interactive rendering.

telemetry_snapshot_normalizer.handoff_note: The standalone snapshot normalizer reuses admission, archive, proof-economy, and SWARM-CTRL-IX high-core evidence artifacts directly. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit either snapshot yet.

high_core_scenario_matrix.handoff_note: The standalone high-core scenario matrix replays deterministic SWARM-CTRL-IX calibration scenarios through the telemetry snapshot normalizer and freezes scrubbed representative outputs as reviewed goldens. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit or compare this matrix yet.

slo_calibrator.handoff_note: The standalone SWARM-CTRL-IX calibrator composes the reviewed high-core scenario matrix, telemetry snapshot, archive pressure scoreboard, and warm-target ROI advisory into deterministic advisory thresholds. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit this receipt yet.

capacity_forecaster.handoff_note: The standalone capacity forecaster consumes the telemetry snapshot plus its normalized child artifacts to publish deterministic confidence-banded risk categories. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit this forecast yet.

admission_budget_planner.handoff_note: The standalone admission budget planner consumes the predictive capacity forecast plus bounded request fixtures to publish deterministic per-priority and per-agent admission budgets. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit this budget plan yet.

truth_constraints: No rich interactive renderer is implemented in franken_engine by this contract.
Any future rich TUI dashboard must be implemented through /dp/frankentui or an explicit ADR exception.
The producer must remain snapshot-fed and must not claim beads, query services, or run cargo commands.
scripts/swarm_operator_status_report.sh remains the single predictive dashboard producer in franken_engine; do not add a second dashboard implementation here.

The high-core scenario matrix is a reviewed fixture and golden surface backed by scripts/swarm_high_core_slo_scenario_matrix.sh; it must not be described as live scheduler tuning, live worker execution, or automatic worker mutation.

The SWARM-CTRL-IX threshold receipt is advisory snapshot evidence backed by scripts/swarm_slo_calibrator.sh; it must not be described as live scheduler tuning, live worker mutation, or automatic resource-governor reconfiguration.
The telemetry quality and capacity forecast sections are advisory snapshots backed by scripts/swarm_capacity_forecaster.sh; they must not be described as live scheduling or automatic worker mutation.

The admission budget section is advisory snapshot evidence backed by scripts/swarm_admission_budget_planner.sh; it must not be described as live worker allocation, queue mutation, or automatic bead claiming.

The lease exchange and salvage section is advisory snapshot evidence backed by scripts/swarm_lease_exchange_cancellation_salvage_simulator.sh; it must not be described as automatic ownership transfer or cancellation.
The prefetch ROI section is advisory snapshot evidence backed by scripts/swarm_warm_target_prefetch_roi_advisory.sh; it must not be described as automatic target warming or archive mutation.
Each integrated dashboard section must carry a deterministic source artifact path so operators can trace the advisory back to its producing JSON.
